seo.metaTitle: Online Doctor Referral | Sunshine Coast Oral, Facial & Implant Specialists
seo.metaDescription: Start your journey to better smile with our reliable and efficient online doctor referral system at SCOFIS.

f3.value: Online referral for dentists and doctors

f4.value: Send a referral in under two minutes. Our team contacts your patient directly to arrange their consultation and keeps you informed of the treatment plan and outcome.

Our vision has always included enduring, collaborative relationships with the practitioners who refer to us. We keep you informed at consultation, after surgery and at discharge, and we return patients to you for ongoing care.

f11.value: Impacted or complex wisdom teeth, especially close to the inferior alveolar nerve

f12.value: Implant placement including immediate, complex and full arch cases

f13.value: Grafting for insufficient bone volume, sinus lifts

f14.value: Zygomatic and pterygoid implants for the atrophic maxilla

f18.value: Medically compromised patients who require hospital based care

f19.value: Prefer to fax or email? Referrals can also be sent to the practice directly. Call {{phone}} for details, or to discuss a case with one of the surgeons.
